checks.evidence: must_read_in_1s: 'Six identical clay post cards; a tiny clay client stands on one.' maps to subjects PR-POSTS and CH-CLIENT, both with state, pose and box; one clear moment.
hands.count_check: 'two visible mitten hands, no fingers, one beyond each shoulder'; contact: 'neither hand touches anything'; region client-hands kind hand boxed.
static: true; action_physics: 'its weight on the card, its soft shadow falling on the card around it' (contact point is the card surface).

props content: 'six identical flat cream #F3E9D8 clay slabs ... each with one small heart red #D64545 clay heart pressed in its lower left corner'; flagged story_critical false but content is filled and the only negative is targeted ('nothing else on them').
text_in_image: none; must_not: 'no letters, words, digits or logos anywhere'; the hook is added in the edit (notes). No text to occlude.
background_rule: 'no signs, frames, posters, screens or writing anywhere'; details: 'from the top edge to 30% and everywhere lower than 52% only plain ground'.

CH-CLIENT pose says 'stands in the centre of the top middle card' but gives y 32% to 40%, while the card is y 30% to 40%: the figure sits 2% from the card top and flush with its bottom edge (its centre is y 36%, the card centre is y 35%, and the 8%-tall figure leaves no margin below). The same box repeats in regions client and client-hands. A model asked for the centre and a box touching the bottom edge may place the figure half off the card, which breaks the 'weight on the card' line.
continuity: previous_shot null, carry_over []; first image of prop and character, stated in subjects.ref.

The figure is seen from straight above with 'no face', yet its facing direction is never given. hands says 'left: ... on the right side of the frame', which is only true if the figure faces down the frame, and 'a thin rim of cream clay at the ears and neck' has no stated side. A model could face the figure up the frame, swapping left and right and putting the neck rim on the wrong side, and a reviewer cannot check the left and right claim.

FL-06 prevented by naming visible parts ('the top of the head and the shoulders visible', 'no face'); FL-11 by 'instances: 1', 'no second figure' and 'its weight on the card'; FL-13 by 'no ... logos anywhere'; FL-04/05/10 by filled card content and the background rule. Other safe-zone arithmetic checks out: 3 x 26% + 2 x 3% = 84% (x 8% to 92%), 2 x 10% + 2% = 22% (y 30% to 52%), inside STANDARDS 6 (top 14%, bottom 35%, 6% sides, faces and key props 15% to 55%).
